concept_uz: Usta dutor yasaydi, nabirasi Malika torni chertib oʻynaydi. U torni roppa-rosa oʻrtasidan bosadi — ovoz oʻsha nota boʻlib, faqat balandroq chiqadi. Usta chizgʻich bilan oʻlchab koʻrsatadi: yoqimli ovoz ortida sodda kasr turibdi — 1/2, 2/3, 3/4; tasodifiy joy esa gʻalati eshitiladi.

facts.claim: Torni aynan oʻrtasidan bosib chertilsa, ovoz balandroq, lekin oʻsha nota boʻlib eshitiladi — oktava
Torning 1/2 qismi — oktava, 2/3 qismi — kvinta, 3/4 qismi — kvarta
Tasodifiy joydan, masalan 7/13 qismidan bosilsa, ovoz gʻalati va noqulay eshitiladi
Rivoyatga koʻra, buni Pifagor va shogirdlari sinchiklab tekshirgan (videoda ham «rivoyatga koʻra» deyiladi); taxminan ikki yarim ming yil oldin
Quloqqa yoqimli juftliklar faqat sodda kasrlar chiqqanda paydo boʻladi
Nota davomiyliklari ham kasr: butun, yarim, chorak; 1/4+1/4+1/4+1/4 = 1 (oxirgi sahnadagi keyingi video ishorasi)

style_line: Cinematic photoreal, warm amber late-afternoon light through a small workshop window, golden mulberry-wood tones and floating sawdust, 35mm film look, intimate gentle mood with a light comic touch. No text, no letters, no watermark.

lines.text: Voy! Xuddi oʻsha ovoz-ku, faqat balandroq!

scenes.prompt: The girl plucks a dutar string, a clear low note rings, then she presses the string at its middle, plucks again and her eyes go wide in surprise; behind her the master looks up over his round spectacles. Audio: a low dutar note, then the same note one octave higher. The girl says in Uzbek with a bright, quick, curious girl's voice of about 12: "Voy! Xuddi o'sha ovoz-ku, faqat balandroq!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Torni roppa-rosa oʻrtasidan bossangiz, ovoz bir oktava koʻtariladi.

scenes.prompt: Extreme close-up: the small finger with the green ribbon presses the string exactly on the white chalk dot at the middle; the string trembles after the pluck, catching the warm light. Audio: a single bright note ringing out. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Torni roppa-rosa o'rtasidan bossangiz, ovoz bir oktava ko'tariladi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bu sehr emas, qizim. Bu — kasr. Torning yarmi: ikkidan bir.

scenes.prompt: The master walks round the bench, picks up the pale wooden ruler, lays it along the dutar's string and taps the middle with his finger, smiling at the girl. Audio: wood tap, soft sawdust rustle. The master says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, unhurried elderly male voice of about 60: "Bu sehr emas, qizim. Bu — kasr. Torning yarmi: ikkidan bir." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Rivoyatga koʻra, ikki yarim ming yil oldin Pifagor va shogirdlari buni sinchiklab tekshirgan.

scenes.prompt: Slow push-in on the ancient scholar plucking his single string while the two students lean closer, one of them moving the small wooden bridge along the box. Audio: a pure single-string tone, wind in the columns. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Rivoyatga ko'ra, ikki yarim ming yil oldin Pifagor va shogirdlari buni sinchiklab tekshirgan." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Uchdan ikki — kvinta. Toʻrtdan uch — kvarta. Ikkalasi ham yoqimli.

scenes.prompt: The master takes the dutar, presses the string at two thirds of its length, plucks, then moves his finger and plucks at three quarters; two warm pleasant notes. The girl listens with her head tilted. Audio: two harmonious dutar notes. The master says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, unhurried elderly male voice of about 60: "Uchdan ikki — kvinta. To'rtdan uch — kvarta. Ikkalasi ham yoqimli." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Tasodifiy joy — gʻalati kasr. Oʻn uchdan yetti — gʻalati ovoz.

scenes.prompt: The girl grabs the dutar back, presses the string at a random spot and plucks: a sour, wobbly note. She scrunches her whole face and covers one ear; the master laughs silently. Comic timing. Audio: an ugly off-key twang. The girl says in Uzbek with a bright, quick, curious girl's voice of about 12: "Bu-chi? Voy, qulog'im!" The master says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, unhurried elderly male voice of about 60: "Tasodifiy joy — g'alati kasr. O'n uchdan yetti — g'alati ovoz." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Ha. Har bir yoqimli ovoz ortida sodda kasr turibdi.

scenes.prompt: The girl plays a short simple melody, her finger hopping between the middle, two thirds and three quarters of the string; the master nods along, tapping a gentle beat on his knee. Audio: a short sweet dutar melody. The girl says in Uzbek with a bright, quick, curious girl's voice of about 12: "Demak, men hozir kasr chalyapmanmi?" The master says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, unhurried elderly male voice of about 60: "Ha. Har bir yoqimli ovoz ortida sodda kasr turibdi." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Notalar ham kasr: butun, yarim, chorak. Qaysi cholgʻuda yana kasr bor? Izohda yozing!
